desc:
The Tisha suppressor represents a breakthrough in compact suppression technology, offering very low backpressure and high muzzle blast suppression in a compact 4.1in K-can suppressor package.

This suppressor draws inspiration from Classic Soviet Bloc aesthetics, with an exterior profile modeled off of the Delta Tek flash hider. The name Tisha is a nod to the Russian word for “quiet.”

This K-sized can punches far above its class, outperforming many full-size suppressors in sound reduction and overall efficacy. The Tisha Inconel is built for shooters who demand maximum durability and heat resistance under the most demanding conditions — including sustained fire and full-auto use — without sacrificing suppression performance.

The sound performance of the Tisha is solid, with four-plus patents pending on its revolutionary design.

The Tisha delivers impressive shooter’s-ear dB readings on platforms like the MK18. Achieving both low backpressure and quiet suppression is a difficult balance — the Tisha accomplishes both, while also delivering very good muzzle blast suppression.

Fully compatible with 1.375×24 hubs, the Tisha ships complete with a Plan B hub and a Plan B muzzle brake (5/8-24 thread), ready to go on your rifle. With the included Plan B muzzle device system, the Tisha adds only 3.8 inches to your rifle’s barrel length.
